relationships.note: He joins them himself: judgment begins in the house of the Lord first, and 1 Corinthians 5:5 made manifest in 2026. The older claim puts the same idea in 2027.
Same country, but darkness is never defined here as blackout, unrest or spiritual condition, so the claims are linked rather than merged.
One is pressure to settle, the other is removal and partition. Same subject, different claims.
Attendance folded into the mechanism, so a miss can be attributed to the audience not showing up.
Hedges the wave by making it conditional on effort, so a loss becomes the church's failure rather than the word's.

On 11 December a public figure's language is excused as immaturity; on 17 December a minister who separates his personal life from his message is in a dangerous place. The standard moves with the subject.
